long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Aşkale, Erzurum, Polat studied business administration at Long Island University and joined Polat Construction after graduating. He began on construction sites, then took charge of the family group's industrial operations, where he expanded ceramic production and helped develop an international business. He later became chairman and chief executive of Polat Holding.

Under his leadership, the group has combined real-estate development with renewable energy, industry and technology investments in Turkey and Europe. Polat also spent years in Galatasaray's administration before serving as club president. He also led Turkish ceramics associations and served as Thailand's honorary consul.
